key.description: Directory name / unique key for this run

cancelled.description: Manifest cancelled flag surfaced verbatim: true means the user stopped it on purpose, distinct from a real failure.

awaitingConfirmation.description: IP DNA stage gate only: the job finished standardizing and is parked waiting for scope confirmation, as opposed to still standardizing under the same status="config".

platformStatus.description: Read-only projection onto the platform's unified state language, derived from status/cancelled/canResume/controls/awaitingConfirmation. Not a second source of truth.

canResume.description: True if this run can be resumed from its checkpoint

parentKey.description: Source run key if this was forked via regenerate

controls.description: Action-guard layer: same primary/cancel computation the canvas uses (pipelineGuards()), so chat can know what actions are currently valid without reading a canvas broadcast.
